title: Where's my blue sock, Dad? I can't see it.
scene: 找不着袜子，翻几个地方。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Where's my blue sock, Dad? I can't see it.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You should check under your bed first.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I looked, and I can't find it under there.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Next you can try the laundry basket.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Oh, I found it! It was hiding inside a shirt.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Socks always like to hide, don't they?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I think this shirt ate my sock!

variations: "blue sock" 换 "red shoe"；"under the bed" 换 "in the closet"。
